items.title: Ecopro Co Ltd (XKRX:086520) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Micron Orders and Recycling ...
items.summary: Ecopro Co Ltd (XKRX:086520) posted strong EcoPro HN growth and secured 113.4 billion won in Micron orders, but weak North American EV demand and currency headwinds weighed on near-term profitability.
